purpose: A deterministic capability catalog. A single user-verified local Factory mode may be inherited automatically; controlled world motion v3 remains independent. Particle-system motion remains unavailable for add.

evidence_levels.user_verified_success: The user previously rendered or otherwise tested this mode successfully.
evidence_levels.user_reported_failure: The user reports that the mode crashes or is unusable; keep it unavailable until retested.
evidence_levels.source_declared_only: The upstream Factory accepts the mode in source, but it is not approved for Director selection.
evidence_levels.asset_specific_validation_required: The base Factory can animate, but generated geometry may break or hide the deformation. Validate the generated asset before enabling it.

local_animation.meaning: Rig, bone, driver, or deformation cycle local to the asset, such as idle swimming, running in place, or a beetle walk cycle.

future_fields.mode: A mode enabled for the selected Factory in this catalog, or null.

local_animation.does_not_imply: World-space displacement. A run cycle alone runs in place.

movement.meaning: World-space/root displacement independent of local_animation, such as hovering, bounded swimming, terrain-following walking, or BOIDS movement.

future_fields.params: Optional bounded overrides validated by the executor.

movement.composition_rule: When both are requested, build and validate local animation first, then apply movement to a stable asset root, placeholder anchor, or particle system without baking away rig deformation.

idle.notes: Verified on the compatible clownfish replacement. Generated assets still require armature/modifier/driver and visible-deformation validation.

roam.notes: Accepted by upstream source but not included in the user-approved tested list.

run.appearance_tradeoff: Infinigen particle hair must be disabled, so a furry generated asset may look smoother.

tpose.notes: The upstream branch is effectively a no-op and is not a useful rendered animation.

run.appearance_tradeoff: Infinigen particle hair must be disabled, so a furry generated asset may look smoother.

BirdFactory.notes: The user reports BirdFactory animation attempts crash. Do not select any mode until a reproducible retest records the exact failure and a verified fix.

FlyingBirdFactory.notes: The user reports FlyingBirdFactory animation attempts crash. Its upstream path movement does not make its local rig mode safe.

DragonflyFactory.notes: Two separate mechanisms, do not confuse them. (1) NO animation_mode: __init__(factory_seed, coarse, bvh, **_) has no such parameter, so a constructor kwarg is silently swallowed and there is no armature -- this catalog therefore lists no selectable mode. (2) The wings DO animate natively: geometry_dragonfly contains a Scene Time node driving wing roll, but generated variants come out with flap magnitude 0.0 at ~20Hz, i.e. invisible. The 0820 idle-adapter PoC normalised it (1.0 Hz, magnitude 0.22) and rendered glowing_blue_butterfly, luna_moth_r3 and mecha_dragonfly successfully (experiments/agent_rigging_poc, strategy native_scene_time, results under output/_test/animation/library_idle_agent_batch). That adapter is NOT wired into the production pipeline yet. Until it is, insect motion in scenes comes from world_motion air_glide / air_hover (anchoring=airborne), which is also how official dragonflies fly (animate_trajectory on the placeholder when bvh is given).

gn_scene_time.node_signature: GeometryNodeInputSceneTime.Seconds -> MATH MULTIPLY -> MATH SINE -> MATH MULTIPLY (amplitude)
gn_scene_time.evidence: 0820 idle-adapter PoC rendered glowing_blue_butterfly / luna_moth_r3 / mecha_dragonfly; anim_robustness tier-1 measured mecha_dragonfly local_deform=11.26% vs blue_morpho_butterfly 0.00% (amplitude zeroed) | 2026-09-12 使用者：1Hz/0.22 在 48 幀影片裡看不出拍翅 → 4Hz/0.6 | 2026-09-12 晚：使用者要再慢 0.4 倍 → 1.6Hz

none.description: Keep the placed anchor fixed. A local animation may still play in place.

aquatic_hover.description: Small, bounded vertical bob plus very small horizontal drift around the placed anchor; intended for pufferfish and other hovering aquatic animals.
required_validations: remain near the requested screen placement

aquatic_wander.description: Slow bounded 3D wandering for individually added fish, with heading aligned to velocity.
required_validations: stay visible for a configured fraction of frames

official_fish_boids.description: Reuse Infinigen's official FishSchoolFactory BOIDS displacement for a school. This is particle-system movement, not an individual FishFactory root trajectory.
official_fish_boids.compatible_deployment: FishSchoolFactory or an existing compatible fish-school particle system
required_validations: particle counts and baked cache remain unchanged during a master replacement
particle instances consume the intended animated master
water-volume and collision settings remain valid

terrain_wander.description: Bounded terrain-following movement for running/walking carnivores, herbivores, and beetles. The local run or walk cycle is selected separately.
required_validations: gait speed approximately matches world speed to reduce foot sliding (future local-animation composition check)
terrain_wander.current_limits: Root follows raycast terrain at every path key and audits slope/contact. Local gait remains a separate capability, and obstacle avoidance is not implemented.

directed_ground_traverse.description: Short one-way terrain-following traverse for a conform-anchored grounded subject.
required_validations: raycast terrain following at every path key

airborne_wander.description: Closed bounded 3D wandering around an airborne anchor. This only moves the root; it does not imply that BirdFactory or FlyingBirdFactory local wing animation works.
required_validations: closed loop returns to the start
local rig animation is reported independently

directed_traverse.description: Move from a chosen start region toward an end region, such as crossing the camera from left to right; useful for running animals or a single fish passing through the shot.
required_validations: start and end remain in the valid habitat

airborne_glide.description: Smooth forward movement with gentle altitude and banking changes for airborne subjects; local wing motion remains a separate capability.

orbit.description: Circle a target object or point of interest while facing inward or following the tangent.

stationary_bob.description: Generic small vertical world-space oscillation without aquatic assumptions; useful for balloons, floating lanterns, or stylized hovering props.

recommended_local_animation.known_issue: The previously generated pufferfish overlay had a moving skinned body hidden by a static unweighted spike shell, so a technically active idle rig looked static. Do not claim success without visible-deformation validation.

recommended_movement.reason: A subtle root-space hover remains visible even if the generated asset cannot safely inherit FishFactory body deformation.

pufferfish.future_fallback: If local idle validation fails, keep local_animation=none but still allow aquatic_hover; report the fallback explicitly.

local_animation_kinds.constructor_mode: Factory accepts animation_mode; placer passes it as a constructor kwarg and the Factory builds its own rig.
local_animation_kinds.gn_scene_time: No constructor mode and no armature: the Factory's geometry nodes already drive motion from a Scene Time node, but generated variants can ship with the amplitude zeroed. placer normalises the instantiated sockets after populate (stage_exec/gn_scene_time.py).
